children: Yemen's Houthi military spokesman Yahya said the group carried out an operation against Saudi military action in Yemen, hitting an arms depot inside a military base in Saudi Arabia's Shearalah area and a command-and-control center responsible for directing and coordinating military operations against Yemen and its people. According to Sina Finance, Yahya said the operation used a large number of ballistic missiles and drones, and that the targets were hit with precise direct strikes. He warned that if Saudi Arabia continues military operations against Yemen, Houthi forces will carry out larger and more intense attacks on deeper targets inside Saudi Arabia, and Saudi Arabia will bear serious consequences.

title: Yemen's Houthi Forces Say They Struck Saudi Military Facilities With Missiles and Drones
